sources.citation: Torsten N. Wiesel, David H. Hubel (1963). Single-Cell Responses in Striate Cortex of Kittens Deprived of Vision in One Eye. Journal of Neurophysiology.
sources.notes: Establishes the early postnatal critical period in primary visual cortex during which monocular deprivation shifts ocular dominance columns.
